security_boundary: The host controller exposes only a pristine condition-view snapshot, submitted patch, sanitized request, and empty output/response directories. The cidfile remains host-only. The sealed pack, operator directory, challenge ground truth, source bank, current Git checkout, credentials, container socket, and host dependency cache are forbidden mounts.

invocation.lifecycle_rule: The controller creates one attempt before full preflight, requires a fresh valid cidfile, caps stdout while the command runs in the foreground, always inspects lifecycle state, performs an idempotent cleanup when the container is present, and confirms the container is absent before publishing. Any preflight, timeout, output, schema, lifecycle, or ordinary runtime failure records checker_terminal_failure. The frozen checker retry limit is zero, so a terminal checker state cannot be re-entered.

sandbox_requirements.capabilities: drop all, then add only SETUID and SETGID to the trusted root controller so each Lean/Lake child can irreversibly enter the sealed worker UID/GID
sandbox_requirements.host_mounts: request/base/patch read-only; separate empty output and response directories writable only by the trusted controller; cidfile host-only
sandbox_requirements.controller_worker_separation: A trusted root controller applies the patch and writes output. It retains only SETUID/SETGID, and every Lean/Lake child irreversibly drops to a distinct sealed worker UID/GID that cannot write the controller response/output or host mounts; patched source is read-only to that worker except for an isolated build cache.
sandbox_requirements.cache: Production constructs a complete .lake dependency seed from the exact common pre-audit Git snapshot inside a digest-pinned multi-stage image build. The minimal build context excludes evaluation/operator data and the final image excludes the builder source snapshot. A byte-complete manifest at /opt/abrl-checker-cache/cache-manifest.json is SBOM- and runtime-bound; the inner checker verifies every cached file, then the already restricted worker copies the seed from /opt/abrl-checker-cache/.lake into the per-run tmpfs replay. Arbitrary cache-prelude commands and host cache mounts are forbidden.
sandbox_requirements.post_run: All worker processes must terminate before the controller atomically writes response.json.

runtime_binding_rule: A canonical digest covers the allowlisted Docker path, executable bytes, Authenticode or package-path ledger, client/server version, daemon identity, exact sealed-launcher foreground/cid-and-label cleanup/inspect argv, absent exit code, immutable image, Git-recomputed base-snapshot build input, build log, recipe/SBOM, complete Lake-cache manifest with baseline provenance, attestations, budgets, worker/cache argv, and actual launcher/controller/inner/probe-runner/contract bytes. The build-input, build-log, cache-manifest, recipe, and SBOM sidecars are copied into the sealed runtime artifact set. Before every probe or production replay, the launcher non-executingly inspects the image and extracts the controller, inner checker, and cache manifest to verify their sealed hashes. The probe report must be generated by the sealed execution runner and bind this digest.
isolation_probe_rule: The sealed probe runner, not an externally authored boolean ledger, invokes the exact production sandbox argv with a nonce-bound probe request. It derives results from protected host bytes, a strictly typed immutable-controller response, raw stdout, cid- and attempt-label lifecycle inspection, and sealed artifacts. Required probes cover network denial, host/operator-data invisibility, worker inability to write checker output/response, patched source/controller input, mounted request/base/patch/cidfile, and background-process reaping.
publication_rule: The host controller rejects links, reparse points, special or multiply linked files, undeclared artifacts, oversized output, input mutation, hash/identity/type/invariant disagreement, and incomplete cleanup. Only a fully validated production bundle is result-eligible and atomically published with state checked; excluded fixtures receive a distinct nonexperimental state and are rejected by grading.
nonclaim: This contract and its deterministic fixture do not establish that a real container image or isolation probe has passed. Production execution remains forbidden until the image digest, command, attestations, and probe report are frozen.
